newsitem.title: BELGIUM: COCERAL puts EU grain crop at 198.49 mlm tonnes.
newsitem.headline: COCERAL puts EU grain crop at 198.49 mlm tonnes.

text.p: COCERAL, the European grain trade association, said on Monday it was forecasting a 1996 European Union grain crop of 198.49 million tonnes, compared with a previous forecast in June of 186.72 million.
In 1995, COCERAL put the crop at 175.40 million tonnes.
It forecast a 1996 soft wheat crop of 88.838 million tonnes from 80.250 million tonnes in 1995.
The 1996 barley crop was put at 52.307 million tonnes, from 44.143 million tonnes in 1995, while the 1996 durum wheat crop was forecast at 7.616 million tonnes, from 5.789 million in 1995.
In its previous estimate in June, COCERAL forecast soft wheat output at 82.98 milion tonnes, barley at 48.53 million and durum wheat at 7.68 million.
The forecast for the 1996 maize crop was 32.42 million tonnes, from 28.88 million in 1965.
